title: Water from the Temple
intro: Ezekiel sees in a vision a river flowing out from the temple, growing into a mighty stream that gives life to everything it touches—even the Dead Sea. The vision points to God's blessing flowing out to the whole world.

items.title: The Water Springs Forth
items.text: Water flowed out from under the threshold of the temple toward the east. It ran on the south side of the altar.

items.title: To the Ankles (1000 cubits)
items.text: The man measured 1000 cubits and led Ezekiel through the water—it reached to his ankles.

items.title: To the Knees (2000 cubits)
items.text: After another 1000 cubits, the water reached to the knees.

items.title: To the Hips (3000 cubits)
items.text: After another 1000 cubits, the water reached to the hips.

items.title: A River to Swim In (4000 cubits)
items.text: After another 1000 cubits, it had become a river that could not be crossed on foot—a river to swim in.

items.title: Trees on Both Banks
items.text: On both sides of the river grew very many trees.

items.title: The Dead Sea Comes Alive
items.text: The water flows down to the Arabah and out into the Dead Sea. When it reaches there, the water becomes fresh. Everything that lives will live wherever the river goes.

items.title: Fishermen by the Sea
items.text: Fishermen will stand along the shore from En-Gedi to En-Eglaim. There will be places for spreading nets, with fish of many kinds—like in the Great Sea.

items.title: Trees Along the River
items.text: Fruit trees of every kind will grow along the river. Their leaves will not wither and their fruit will never fail. Each month they will bear fresh fruit, because the water comes from the sanctuary.

footer.title: Fulfillment
footer.content: Jesus said that streams of living water will flow from those who believe (John 7:38). Revelation 22 describes the river of life flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb—the final fulfillment of this vision.
